versions.changelog: Maintenance re-release. Identical map data to 1.1.0 (version bumped to force a clean re-download). Published while investigating a reported building-collision error that could not be reproduced from the map data; building geometry verified valid (all 43,822 footprints closed).
Added new buildings_index.bin for 1.4.x compatibility. Fixed neighborhood labels.

Updated demand data from LODES 2022 to LODES 2023 to reduce COVID-era commute distortion. 334 demand points, 346,040 residents, 346,040 jobs, 6,659 commute OD pairs (up from 333 points / 328,405 / 6,451 on 2022 data).

Initial public release. Tri-Cities, WA (Kennewick-Pasco-Richland) map built from US Census LODES 2022 tract-level origin-destination commute data (333 demand points, 328,405 residents, 328,405 jobs, 6,451 commute OD pairs; DEMAND_FACTOR=5). Special demand for Tri-Cities Airport (PSC; 2,700 daily pax), three universities (WSU Tri-Cities, Columbia Basin College, Heritage University-TC), and TRAC event center. Includes 43,822-entry buildings collision index, PSC runway+taxiway layer, and multi-scale labels (3 cities, 8 suburbs, 25 neighborhoods) via OpenStreetMap Overpass API place nodes.
